test_title: PYST 147: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 01 Feb,, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the following sentence.**

His ancestors are **__native__** to this place.
solution: The correct answer is **"Foreign."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Native"** means originating or belonging to a particular place or country. (जन्‍म स्‍थान या निवास-स्‍थान से संबंधित) • **Example**: *What is your **native**__ language?* • **"Foreign"** means belonging to or coming from another country or place. (स्‍वदेश से भिन्‍न देश का या उससे संबंधित; विदेशी) __ • **Example**: *She belongs to a **foreign**__ country.* • The antonym of** "native"** is **"foreign."** • The correct answer is Option 4. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1: "Innate"** means natural or inborn, and is not an antonym of "native." ((योग्‍यता और गुण) जन्‍मजात, अंतर्निहित) • **Option 2: "Community"** refers to a group of people living in the same place or having a particular characteristic in common, and is not an antonym of "native." (एक समूह के रूप में संगठित स्‍थान-विशेष के समस्‍त निवासी; समुदाय) • **Option 3: "Enemy"** refers to a person who is actively opposed or hostile to someone or something, and is not an antonym of "native." (शत्रु, दुश्‍मन, विरोधी) 39:T659, The correct answer is "**Where the difficulty lies.**"
